bio: This sleek, pared-back establishment, housed in a historic building and boasting an exquisite rear terrace overlooking a leafy public park, is the HQ of a couple whose story is atypical. Chef Dimitry Lysens and your hostess, Aagje Moens, have opted for the road less travelled, swapping their marketing and economics degrees for a career in hospitality. They also share a belief that work should be about more than simply earning a living and that you do well that which you enjoy. Thus, dining here is not simply about eating — it’s an experience! Chef Lysens champions simplicity as he allows the ingredients to shout their name. The spotlight is on ultra-fresh, preferably local produce and subtle craftsmanship.
